audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 contradicted this page's own whys prose and both packets. win[1]/phases[1].side said Skill while whys[1] says 'Level 2 stays his'; win[2]/phases[2].side said Yorick while whys[2] says 'Level 3 is still Pantheon's'. win[4] said Pantheon while whys[4] said 'Level 6 is skill-based'.
audit.why: Levels 1-3 are unambiguously Pantheon's — Comet Spear pokes from 575 on 11s, Shield Vault dashes in and stuns on 13s, and Aegis Assault blocks frontal damage on 22s, none of which Yorick answers before he has a real swarm. Every independent source agrees on rows 0-2: the yorick packet, the pantheon packet as reported by the mirror, and the whys text.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side and win[2]/phases[2].side flipped to Pantheon as a paired group, ratings to 3/10 each. Row 4 left at Pantheon and whys[4] rewritten to agree with it rather than flipping the side — see notes and questions.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] and mid both credit Yorick a 'Maiden' at level 4, and no spike carried a cooldown (packet defect: sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is level 6 at 160s rank 1 — at level 4 Yorick has graves and Mourning Mist, nothing more. The level 4 flip is real but it comes from the first full ghoul swarm, not the Maiden. Pantheon's real clock: Comet Spear 11s, Shield Vault 13s, Aegis Assault 22s, Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: whys[3], mid, phases[3].why corrected to name the ghoul swarm; the cooldowns written into phases[0..5].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says three times that Pantheon's passive blocks your autos — spikes[0].text ('his passive block on your autos'), early ('his passive auto-block') and wants.foe[1] ('Passive to block your key autos in trades'). It also never mentions that Aegis Assault only blocks one direction, or that Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's Mortal Will text is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered' — there is no auto-blocking in it at all. The block belongs to Aegis Assault (E): 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front'. That distinction is the whole matchup for Yorick, because it means the swarm hitting him from any other angle goes straight through — mark him with Mourning Mist and bring the Walkers in behind the shield instead of standing in front of it. Aegis Assault is also a channel, but Yorick has no hard CC to interrupt it, so the positional answer is the only one. Shield Vault (13/12/11/10/9s) resets his auto, so the wind-up is the tell rather than the cast.
audit.corrected: The passive auto-block claim removed from spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[1]. Aegis Assault's front-only invulnerability now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d, phases[2].why, phases[3].why and mid. Shield Vault's auto reset stated in dontsFull[0].d, phases[1].why and spikes[0].text.

notes: Fabrication corrected in three fields: Pantheon's passive does NOT block autos. Chart: rows 1 and 2 flipped because the yorick packet, the pantheon packet (per the mirror's note) and this page's own whys all say Pantheon. Rows 3 and 4 left alone deliberately — the two packets disagree there and the pantheon__yorick auditor explicitly declined to touch sides for the same reason, so whys[4] was brought into line with the existing side rather than the side flipped.
